hook_text: Left and right change every time you turn. North never does.
clip_script: School camp at Golden Gate in the Free State. The sun comes up over the mountains: that way is east. It sets in the evening: west. Hold a compass flat and the needle swings round to point north. Behind you is south. Going clockwise: North, East, South, West. Never Eat Soggy Weet-Bix. On a map, north is usually at the top, shown by an arrow with the letter N. The dam is north of the camp. The stream is to the west. Directions that never change.
visual_style: Whiteboard compass rose spinning into place, then a camp map with a north arrow and little arrows pointing from the camp to each feature.
pacing: Sunrise for east, sunset for west, compass for north, then the mnemonic, then the map.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find out which direction your classroom door faces.
